title: Is this ancient Swahili town at risk from Kenya’s energy boom
html:
Is this ancient Swahili town at risk from Kenya’s energy boom

East Africa is betting billions on oil infrastructure to strengthen energy security and reduce dependence on imported fuel. But as the region races to build its own refining capacity, concerns are growing over how industrial pollution and habitat destruction could ruin the unique appeal of Lamu Old Town.
summary: East Africa is betting billions on oil infrastructure to strengthen energy security and reduce dependence on imports.
